messages.text: Leo's match is at Hackney Marshes at 10, and we're meeting Mum at Borough Market afterwards. How long is the drive between them?

About 25 minutes by car, 8.3 km along Victoria Park Road. The match ends at 11:30, so leaving by 12:00 gets you to the market for 12:30 with time to park.

https://maps.apple.com/directions?source=Hackney%20Marshes,%20London&destination=Borough%20Market,%20London&mode=driving
Perfect. Leo's boots are in the car?
In the boot, with his shin pads and a spare pair of socks.
Your Saturday is clear after 10. I told Clara you are offline until Monday.

intro.title: Saturday, mapped
intro.subtitle: Alfred plans the drive, the lunch and the walk with Apple Maps.

outro.tagline: A workspace for you and your AI agents.

type.text: Book lunch near the market for five. Mum can't manage stairs, and she'd love a walk by the river afterwards.

toolCall.title: Searching Apple Maps
toolCall.input: messenger tool maps search --query restaurant --near "Borough Market, London" --limit 3
toolCall.output:
1. Roast, The Floral Hall, Stoney Street, London (51.505576, -0.091179)
2. Akara, 18 Stoney Street, London (51.506374, -0.09161)
3. Café François, 14-16 Stoney Street, London (51.505931, -0.091726)

reply.text:
Booked: Roast, in the Floral Hall above the market, a table for five at 12:45. I asked for step-free access and they will seat you by the lift.

https://maps.apple.com/?ll=51.505576,-0.091179&q=Roast

toolCall.title: Planning the walk
toolCall.input: messenger tool maps directions --from "Borough Market, London" --to "Tate Modern, London" --mode walking
toolCall.output: Borough Market to Tate Modern on foot via Park Street: 800 m (0.5 mi), 10 min.

reply.text:
For afterwards, Tate Modern is a flat 10-minute walk via Park Street, and the river is right there when you arrive.

https://maps.apple.com/directions?source=Borough%20Market,%20London&destination=Tate%20Modern,%20London&mode=walking
